description:
The Generator Guide is the independent buyer's guide to home backup power.

We don't sell generators — so we can tell you what dealers won't: real installed prices, honest Generac vs Kohler vs Cummins comparisons, what size you actually need, and how to read a quote like a pro.

New videos every week on costs, sizing, fuel choices, installation, permits, and maintenance.

Based in Houston, TX — helping homeowners everywhere the power goes out.
